patch_description: The current program already uses greedy construction + iterated SA, but underperforms the prior best (244 vs 256 makespan). Following the recommendation, I add Or-opt segment moves (extract a contiguous block of length 1–3 and reinsert it elsewhere) as a dedicated move type in the SA neighborhood, alternating with single-transaction insertion moves. Segment reinsertions let the annealer relocate coherent chains of mutually-conflicting transactions at once, escaping local optima that single-element moves cannot. I also make the acceptance phase slightly greedier (reheat kick threshold tightened) and reserve time for a stronger final local-search polish. This richer neighborhood should recover and improve on the prior best makespan while keeping validity and schedule metrics unchanged.
